summary: MaintProgramProfileHistory is a UserControl in the HSPnet web application system, responsible for presenting and managing program profile history data. The control interacts with a data source and utilizes session information for data retrieval and access control.
purpose: To display and manage the historical profile information of a Program entity within the HSPnet system, ensuring access and data retrieval depend on the user's session and agency affiliation.

fields.name: ProgramID
fields.purpose: Identifies the program whose profile history is being displayed/manipulated.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.purpose: Provides session context such as AgencyID for permission and data scoping.

workflows.name: Program Profile History Retrieval
steps: UserControl is initialized with UserSession and ProgramID.
When dsProgramProfileHistory data source is selected, dsProgramProfileHistory_Selecting is triggered.
If UserSession is null, the selection event is cancelled and no data is retrieved.
If UserSession is valid, input parameters for ProgramID, SessionAgencyID, and UserSession are set for the data source query.
Data is retrieved via ObjectDataSource, presented in GridView (gridData).

business_rules: Only users with an active session (UserSession not null) may retrieve program profile history.
Program profile history is scoped to the user's agency (SessionAgencyID).
validations: ProgramID must be provided and valid.
conditions: UserSession != null: Set relevant parameters and proceed.
system_behavior: Cancels data retrieval if session is missing.
Passes session and program parameters to the data source for secure/scoped access.
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, data retrieval is prevented (event is cancelled).
content_gaps: No explicit details on what fields are shown in gridData (actual historical profile attributes).
No information on error handling beyond session validation.
No business rule details on editing or deleting history records.
